MINUTES OF THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN LIMITED (“COMPANY”) HELD ON 2 5 th DAY OF AUGUST 2020 
 
 Agenda 
 
 ADVANCEMENT OF LOAN TO ZAMEEN MEDIA (PRIVATE) LIMITED 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to advance a loan in the principal amount of AED 3, 6 00,000 (Emirati Dirham Three Million Six Hundred Thousand) to Zameen Media (Private) Limited (“ Borrower ”). The Board unanimously nominated Gilles Christophe Marc Blanchard , Director of the Company, t o discuss, neg otiate , and accept this proposal . 
 
 Resolutions 
 
 After discussing the aforesaid matter in detail, the following resolutions were passed/approved/adopted by the Board: 
 
 Resolved by the Board that the Company advance a loan in the principal amount of AED 3, 6 00,000 (Emirati Dirham Three Million Six Hundred Thousand) to the Borrower . 
 
 Resolved further by the Board that Gilles Christophe Marc Blanchard is hereby authorized and empowered to do and execute all such acts, deeds and things as may be necessary and ancillary to the aforementioned transaction . 
 
 
 
 _____________________________ 
 Gilles Christophe Marc Blanchard 
 Director
